title: Finite evaluation of the section-normalized system pullback compositor
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and schemes $X,Y,Z$ with morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the strict coefficient-system derived categories $\mathscr D_W=D(\mathscr S_W)$, the specified pullbacks $P_h$, and any simultaneous operations $o$ and section-normalized compositors $c$ of [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. For $n\geq0$ let $e_{W,n}$ be actual derived evaluation at the positive quotient $A_{n+1}$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Let $p_{h,n}$ be the intrinsic finite pullback and $a_{f,g,n}:p_{gf,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}p_{g,n}p_{f,n}$ its canonical compositor [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square]. Let $\epsilon_{h,n}:P_h e_{U,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}e_{V,n}p_{h,n}$ denote the specified cochain-normalized evaluation isomorphism [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], with functors written in diagrammatic order. Then for every $N\in\mathscr D_Z$,
$$e_{X,n}(c_{f,g,N}^{-1});\epsilon_{gf,n,N}=\epsilon_{f,n,P_gN};p_{f,n}(\epsilon_{g,n,N});a_{f,g,n,e_{Z,n}N}^{-1}.$$
Here semicolons denote composition in written order. Both sides go from $e_{X,n}(P_fP_gN)$ to $p_{gf,n}(e_{Z,n}N)$. No normalization, finite-Tor, constructibility, or geometric finiteness condition is imposed. The equation compares the specified maps, not arbitrary lifts of finite evaluations.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary module-sheaf evaluation square for the section-normalized compositor, including transport through the unit-normalized intrinsic level comparison. This is the only remaining split-off obligation; it contains no complexes or localization.

Identify c.pullComp with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(c.ordinaryPull) followed by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso: use localization extensionality, cancel the exact-functor factors, and compare c.pullComp_model with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_hom_app_factors. Identify each specified derived evaluation with mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of its ordinary square by its unique cochain normalization.

Apply exact derived-square composition to the ordinary square. Substitute the identified derived compositor and evaluations; the intrinsic finite derived compositor is defined by exactly the same localization. A generic categorical square calculation precomposes with the inverse system compositor and postcomposes with the inverse intrinsic compositor, cancelling both pairs to obtain the required inverse orientation.

lean.statement:
theorem systemPullbackCompositorEvaluation
    (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (n : ℕ) (N : System l E Z) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map ((c.pullComp f g).inv.app N) ≫
      (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E (f ≫ g) n).hom.app N =
    (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).hom.app ((pull l E g).obj N) ≫
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        ((pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E g n).hom.app N) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedPullbackComp (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
        f g).inv.app ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E Z n).obj N)
